critical_code_review_comments: _compute_honors runs an O(N) scan of every non-suspended retailer for the Constant Companion badge on every patron status read — this will get slow at scale. Consider caching top streak per hour, or persisting a lightweight 'monthly streak leaderboard' collection.

sync_achievements uses `>=` on stat vs threshold for GMV without rounding — float comparison edge-case exists at exactly the threshold boundary, but not a real risk given INR amounts are typically integers.
Manifest endpoints extension is a plain dict inside app_config router — consider unit-testing the manifest structure (already done in iter79 test).
